test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

Suraj has always shown a willingness to accept and respect the differences in others' lives with impartiality and avoid __prejudice__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Impartiality".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prejudice means preconceived opinion that is not based on reason or actual experience; bias. (पूर्वाग्रह)
 
 
• Example: We must fight against prejudice and encourage equality and understanding.
 
 
 
• Impartiality means equal treatment of all rivals or disputants; fairness. (निष्पक्षता)
 
 
• Example: The judge is known for his impartiality in dealing with all the cases.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Willingness means the quality or state of being prepared to do something; readiness. (इच्छुकता)
 
• Avoid means to keep away from or stop oneself from doing (something). (टालना)
 
• Differences means points or ways in which people or things are not the same. (अंतर)
